items: Kasb: She's **a** doctor. (~~She's doctor~~)
Umumiy gap — ko'plik/sanalmaydigan artiklsiz: **Life** is short. **Water** is important. Aniq bo'lsa — the: **The water** in this bottle…
**the** bilan: daryo, okean, tog' tizmasi, ko'plikdagi davlatlar (**the** Nile, **the** USA, **the** UK), cholg'ular (play **the** piano), superlativ (**the** best), tartib son (**the** first).

**artiklsiz**: shaharlar, ko'pchilik davlatlar, ko'llar, alohida tog'lar, ovqatlar (have **breakfast**), sport (play **football**), tillar, **go to work / school / bed / hospital** (vazifasi bo'yicha).
**at home, by car, on foot, next week, last year** — artiklsiz.
**the + sifat** = guruh: **the** rich, **the** elderly, **the** unemployed.
**the + birlik** = tur (rasmiy): **The** tiger is endangered.
go to **school** (o'quvchi sifatida) ↔ go to **the** school (ota-ona yig'ilishiga).
**a** ma'nosi "har biri": twice **a** week, $10 **an** hour.
Ma'no farqi: **a** few / few, **a** little / little (ijobiy / salbiy).
Tinglovchi "**qaysi?**" deb so'rashi mumkinmi? Mumkin → **a**. Biladi → **the**.
Sanaladigan birlik ot **hech qachon yalang'och** turmaydi: a/the/my/this kerak.
Umumlashtiryapsizmi (barcha itlar, umuman musiqa)? → **artiklsiz**.

items: Talaffuzda qisqaradi: should've /ʃʊdəv/, could've, would've, must've. Yozishda ~~should of~~ — xato!

Turlar: email (rasmiy/norasmiy), fikr insho, xat, qisqa hisobot.
Hedging: *It could be argued that…*, *This suggests that…*
Nominalization: *decide → decision*, *We analysed it* → *The analysis showed…*
Inversion va cleft bilan urg'u: *Not only does it…*, *What matters most is…*
Yozib bo'lgach **AI chatda** tekshiring: "Mening xatolarimni ko'rsat, tuzatma" — avval o'zingiz tuzating.
Xatolar — mistake bank'ga.
150 so'z: "Is social media more harmful than useful?" Bugungi grammar mavzusidan 2 ta tuzilma.

blocks.x: Maslahat zinapoyasi (yumshoqdan kuchliga):
Ochilishlar: **If I were you, I'd…**, **Have you thought about…?**, **Why don't you…?**, **It might be worth + -ing**

items: O'tmish tahlili: You **should have**… / You **could have**… / It **must have been** hard.
Empatiya + maslahat: **I know it's tough, but…**, **I'd be careful about…**
Nozik tanqid: **It might not be the best idea to…**, **I'm not sure I'd…**
Ehtimol + taxmin: He **can't have** known. She **might have** misunderstood.
Hech qachon **You must** dan boshlamang — qo'pol eshitiladi. **I'd** / **You could** — xavfsiz.
Do'stingiz ishdan charchagan. 1 daqiqa maslahat bering.
Kamida: 3 xil maslahat shakli, 1 ta should have V3.

blocks.x: **PREP** formulasi: **Point → Reason → Example → Point**.

blocks.en: I think remote work is better. **The main reason is** time — no commute. **For example**, I save two hours a day. **That's why** I prefer it.

items: Ikkala tomon: **On the one hand… On the other hand…**, **While it's true that…, …**
Rozi emaslik: **I see your point, but…**, **I'm not entirely convinced…**
Yumshatish: **I'd say…**, **To some extent…**, **It depends on…**
**What really matters is…**, **The thing is…**, **It's not so much X as Y.**
**Not only… but also**, **Admittedly,…**, **Be that as it may,…**
Qarshi dalilni oldindan yopish: **Some might argue that…, but…**
Har javob **2 daqiqa**: 20 soniya fikr, 1 daqiqa sabab+misol, 20 soniya qarshi tomon, 20 soniya xulosa.
"Should university be free?" — 2 daqiqa, yozib oling.
Kamida: PREP, 2 ta hedge, 1 ta inversion, 1 ta cleft.

blocks.x: Odam, joy, narsani tasvirlash: **umumiy → tafsilot → his**.

blocks.en: It's a small café **which** is hidden behind the market. The owner, **who** is really friendly, makes the best coffee **I've ever had**.

items: Sifatlar zanjiri (tartib): **opinion → size → age → colour → origin** (a lovely small old red Italian car).
Taqqoslash: It's **much bigger than**…, **not as… as**, **the most… I've ever**.
Noaniq: **kind of**, **sort of**, **-ish** (greenish, thirtyish).
Reduced relatives: a man **wearing** a hat, a house **built** in 1900.
Kuchli sifatlar: huge, tiny, stunning, filthy, freezing, packed.
Taassurot: **It gives off a… vibe**, **It reminds me of…**, **What strikes you first is…**
"good, nice, bad" — **taqiq**. O'rniga aniq so'z: delicious, cosy, chaotic.
Sevimli joyingizni 1 daqiqa tasvirlang.
Kamida: 2 ta who/which, 1 ta reduced clause, 3 ta kuchli sifat.

blocks.x: "What would you do if…?" — IELTS va suhbatlarda eng ko'p savol.

blocks.en: If I **won** the lottery, I'**d** travel first, then I'**d** probably invest.

blocks.x: Javob qolipi: **javob → sabab → misol → shart**.

items: O'tmish afsusi: If I **had known**…, I **would have**… / I **wish I had**…
Aralash: If I **had studied** harder, I'**d be** in a better job **now**.
Vaqt yutish: **That's a tough one…**, **I've never really thought about it, but…**
**Were I to…**, **Had it not been for…**, **Suppose…**, **Imagine if…**
**Assuming that…**, **Provided that…**, **Otherwise…**
Savolni o'zingizga qaytaring: "If I could live anywhere? Hmm… I'd probably choose…" — 3 soniya vaqt yutasiz.
"If you could change one decision in your life, what would it be?" — 1.5 daqiqa.
Kamida: 3-shart, aralash shart, 1 ta wish.

blocks.x: Uch qavat: **reja** (going to / present continuous), **bashorat** (will / might), **shart** (if + present).

blocks.en: Next year I'**m going to** move to a new job. I **think** it **will** be hard at first, but if I **work** hard, I'**ll** manage.

blocks.x: Ochilishlar: **I'm planning to…**, **I'm hoping to…**, **I've decided to…**, **My goal is to…**

items: Ishonch darajasi: **definitely** → **probably** → **might** → **probably won't** → **definitely won't**.
**By the end of the year I'll have…** — natijani ko'rsatish.
**This time next year I'll be…** — kelajakdagi tasvir.
**I'm on the verge of…**, **I'm due to…**, **The plan is to…**
Ehtimol: **There's a good chance that…**, **I doubt that…**, **Chances are…**
Rejadan voz kechish: **I was going to…, but…**
Har javobda **reja + sabab + shubha** formulasi: I'm going to X **because** Y, **although** Z might happen.
"Where do you see yourself in 5 years?" — 1.5 daqiqa.
Kamida: going to, will have V3, will be -ing, 1 ta "chances are".

blocks.x: Video, maqola yoki suhbatni **o'z so'zlaringiz bilan** aytish. Paraphrase — C1 ning asosiy ko'nikmasi.

items: **He said that…**, **She told me…**, **According to…**, **The main idea was that…**

blocks.x: Reporting verbs bilan jonli:

items: He **admitted** making a mistake.
She **suggested** trying again.
They **refused** to comment.
He **warned** us not to…
Xulosa: **In a nutshell…**, **The gist of it is…**, **What he was getting at was…**
Masofa: **Apparently…**, **Allegedly…**, **He is said to have…**
O'z fikrini qo'shish: **I'm not sure I agree with him, though.**
**3 ta kalit so'z** yozing (boshqa hech narsa) va 1 daqiqa qayta ayting. Matnga qaramang.
3–5 daqiqalik inglizcha video ko'ring, 1 daqiqada qayta ayting.
Kamida: 3 xil reporting verb.

blocks.x: Hikoya = **fon → voqea → natija**. Fon — past continuous, voqealar — past simple, oldingi voqea — past perfect.

blocks.en: It was raining and I **was waiting** for the bus. Suddenly a car **stopped**. The driver **had seen** me before…

blocks.x: Tayyor qolip:

items: **Boshlash**: So, the other day… / Last summer… / You won't believe what happened…
**Davom**: Then… / After that… / All of a sudden…
**Tugatish**: In the end… / So that's how… / Looking back, I…

blocks.x: **1-2-3 qoidasi**: 1 daqiqa, 2 ta tafsilot (rang, his, ovoz), 3 ta bog'lovchi so'z.

items: His qo'shing: I was **so nervous**. I **couldn't believe** my eyes.
Ishlatish uchun ifodalar: **It turned out that…** (ma'lum bo'ldiki), **To make matters worse…**, **Luckily / Unfortunately…**
Jonli hikoya — present tense: So I **walk** in, and there **he is**…
Hikoya ichida fikr: **I remember thinking** "this is a disaster".
Kulminatsiya oldidan pauza va intonatsiya ko'tarilishi.
Inversiya bilan: **No sooner had I** left **than** it started raining.
5 ta tayyor hikoyangiz bo'lsin (sayohat, ish, bolalik, xato, quvonch). Har haftada bir xil hikoyani **yangi grammatika** bilan qayta ayting.
Yozib oling (ovoz yozish), tinglang, 1 ta xatoni toping — mistake bank'ga.
"Tell me about a time you got lost" — 1 daqiqa, telefonga yozib oling.
Kamida: 1 ta past continuous, 1 ta past perfect, 1 ta **It turned out that**.

used-to.title: used to / would / be used to

blocks.x: **used to + V1** — o'tmishda bor edi, hozir yo'q (odat yoki holat).

blocks.en: I **used to smoke**.
There **used to be** a cinema here.

blocks.x: **would** — o'tmishdagi takroriy **harakat** (hikoyada, nostalgiya). Holat uchun emas.

blocks.en: Every summer we **would go** to the mountains.
I **used to have** long hair.

blocks.x: **be used to + -ing / ot** — ko'nikkan; **get used to** — ko'nikib borish:

blocks.en: I'**m used to getting** up early.
You'll soon **get used to** the noise.

items: **would** hikoyada birinchi gapdan keyin used to o'rnini egallaydi: When I was a kid, I **used to** spend summers at my gran's. She **would** wake me at six…
**will** — hozirgi odat (ba'zan jahl bilan): He **will** leave his socks everywhere!
**be accustomed to + -ing** — rasmiy sinonim.
**to** dan keyin -ing kelsa (be/get used **to** + -ing) — bu yerdagi "to" predlog. Tekshiruv: o'rniga ot qo'yib bo'ladimi? (used to **the noise**) — bo'lsa, -ing.
Holat fe'li (be, have, live, know) bo'lsa → **used to**, would emas.
~~I'm used to wake up early~~ → I'm used to **waking** up early
~~I didn't used to~~ → I didn't **use** to
~~I use to play~~ (hozirgi) → I usually play
"Bolaligimda Samarqandda yashar edim" → I **used to live** in Samarkand as a child.
"Hali bu shaharga ko'nikmadim" → I'**m not used to** this city yet.

blocks.x: Ilovadagi **So'zlar** bo'limi: yangi so'zlar (kvota) + takror. Kartani bosing → javob ochiladi → **Hard / Normal / Easy** ni o'zingiz tanlang.

items: **Hard** — bilmadim yoki ikkilandim → tez-tez qaytadi
**Normal** — esladim, lekin o'yladim
**Easy** — darhol bildim → kam qaytadi (30 kundan keyin yana tekshiriladi)

blocks.x: 💡 O'zingizni aldamang: 2 soniyadan ortiq o'ylasangiz — Easy emas.
**Collocation** — so'zlar juftligi. Alohida so'zdan muhimroq, chunki tayyor bo'laklar bilan gapirasiz.
Asosiy fe'llar: **make, do, take, have, get, give, keep, pay, catch, break** — har biri bilan 10 ta collocation.

items: **Phrasal verbs** — ma'no bo'yicha guruhlang: look into (tekshirmoq), come up with (o'ylab topmoq), put off (kechiktirmoq).
**Sinonimlar nozikligi**: big / large / huge / enormous; look / see / watch / stare / glance.
**Register**: get → obtain (rasmiy), buy → purchase, help → assist.
Har yangi so'zni **gap ichida** o'rganing, alohida emas: ~~ambitious = shuhratparast~~ → *She's very **ambitious** — she wants to be CEO.*
Kuniga 3 ta yangi so'zni **o'sha kuni** speaking'da ishlating.
Hard so'zlar ro'yxatini kechqurun 1 marta ovoz chiqarib o'qing.
So'zlar: yangi kvota + takror (ilova ko'rsatadi).
Bugungi 3 ta so'z bilan 3 ta gap tuzib ayting.

wish.title: wish / if only / I'd rather / it's time

blocks.x: **If only** — xuddi wish, lekin kuchliroq his: **If only** I **had** listened!

items: **be** — were (rasmiy), was (gapirishda): I wish I **were** taller.
**wish + would** o'zingiz haqida emas: ~~I wish I would~~ → I wish I **could** / **did**.
**I'd rather + V1** (o'zim): I'**d rather stay** home.
**I'd rather + kimdir + past**: I'**d rather you didn't** smoke here.
**It's (high) time + past** / **to V1**: It's time we **left**. It's time **to go**.
**would rather + have V3**: I'**d rather have stayed** home.
**Suppose / Supposing + past**: Suppose you **lost** your job?
**as if / as though + past** (xayoliy): He talks **as if** he **knew** everything.
wish'dan keyin har doim **bir qadam orqaga**: hozir → past, o'tmish → past perfect.
Boshqadan shikoyat → **would**; o'zingizning qobiliyatingiz → **could**.
~~I wish I have~~ → I wish I **had**
~~I wish I didn't say that~~ (o'tmish) → I wish I **hadn't said**
~~It's time we go~~ → It's time we **went** / It's time **to go**
"Qani endi ko'proq vaqtim bo'lsa" → I wish I **had** more time.
"Qani endi o'sha gapni aytmagan bo'lsam" → I wish I **hadn't said** that.
